scope: Refresh downstream DXF 3D-consumer evidence and clarify topology-level acceptance without creating a local defect finding or promoting support.

method.kind: Current primary project source, issue report, and Autodesk DXF reference
method.evidenceBoundary: FreeCAD main source is mutable route evidence, not a pinned-binary result. Issue #31716 has no attached DXF, entity inventory, or converter/importer trace and does not identify a libdxfrw defect. Autodesk's 3DSOLID group-code reference describes the DXF carrier boundary but not ACIS/SAB internals or shape validity.

findings.topic: Import success, object presentation, and shape topology are distinct outcomes
observed: The current FreeCAD C++ DXF importer constructs a TopoDS_Edge for a LINE callback and can publish generic shapes; successful object creation therefore does not itself establish a face, shell, or solid result.
Open FreeCAD issue #31716 reports that a user on development build 26.3.0dev.20260728 at commit 63af5cb2f saw many lines after importing a file described as 3D-DXF despite a solid-like tree icon.
The issue provides no DXF, source entity census, converter trace, or selected importer details, so neither its cause nor the relevant entity family can be independently determined.
doesNotEstablish: a defect in libdxfrw or a failure on any known source entity
a defect in the pinned FreeCAD release already tested in this repository
that FreeCAD accepted or rejected ACIS payload data
that every generic FreeCAD shape callback has equivalent topology semantics
findings.planUse: At the composed consumer checkpoint, record parser/callback delivery, document object count, and topology counts independently. Require source-family-specific expected geometry; do not count an icon, label, nonempty feature, or successful import as 3D geometry evidence. Treat issue #31716 as an unresolved diagnostic lead only.

findings.topic: 3DSOLID carrier is separate from explicit DXF geometry and solid semantics
observed: The 3DSOLID DXF entity includes the AcDbModelerGeometry subclass, a modeler format version, proprietary group-1/group-3 data, the AcDb3dSolid subclass, and an optional soft-owner history handle in group 350.
These carrier fields are distinct from explicit SOLID, 3DFACE, mesh, and line entities and do not by themselves prove payload decoding or a valid B-rep.
doesNotEstablish: the internal ACIS/SAB schema or version-specific compatibility
a complete entity-to-history-object or AcDs owner graph
shape validity, closedness, exact surfaces, or dimensions
findings.planUse: Keep entity/carrier association and payload disposition separate from B-rep reconstruction. Solid claims require topology, validity/closedness, coordinates/bounds, and area/volume where applicable; byte retention alone remains carrier-only evidence.

consumerReceiptFields: input hash and source entity/owner/block-path census
converter identity, options, status, and output DXF version/hash
selected importer/backend, open-versus-insert operation, and effective preferences
warnings, skipped/unsupported disposition, parser/callback and object counts
topology counts for vertices, edges, wires, faces, shells, solids, and compounds
entity-specific expected coordinates, frame/winding, bounds, and topology
B-rep validity/closedness and analytic area/volume for solid claims
implementationReadiness.fastVsComposed: Keep per-slice validation on touched strict targets, focused generated tests, applicable compatibility builds, and diff checks. Run FreeCAD/native peer qualification only at the existing composed checkpoint; do not add routine CTest registrations or external dependencies.
implementationReadiness.issue31716Disposition: UNRESOLVED_DIAGNOSTIC_LEAD; no source file supplied; no local or support finding; do not add as a fixture. Re-evaluate only if an admissible source artifact and exact route are provided.
